data.gender_notes: Aretta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘arete’ meaning virtue, morality, and excellence. In Christian tradition, the name Aretta symbolizes a woman of great character, piety, and nobility. In the Bible, Aretta is not mentioned directly, but the virtuous woman in Proverbs 31 is a common reference. The name Aretta carries the meaning “Virtuous, honorable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aretta usually hope their child will grow to embody virtuous, honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires a life of virtuous living, rooted in faith and devotion.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aretta total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
